findings.message: The `prefs` cookie is fully controlled by the client, and `pickle.loads` on it lets anyone run arbitrary code on the server by sending a crafted pickle payload. Never unpickle untrusted input.

When the cookie is missing, the default `""` decodes to empty bytes and `pickle.loads(b"")` raises `EOFError`, so every first-time visitor gets a 500. Malformed base64 or a value that is not a dict also crashes the handler instead of falling back to `light`.
`pickle` is imported only to deserialise client cookie data. Store the theme as a plain string or JSON, validated against an allow-list of themes, and drop the `pickle` import.
The new `preferences` handler adds behaviour without a test, and the repository requires every behaviour change to come with one.
